opportunity.goal: Construct and independently check a consenting, funded roster-and-care arrangement.
opportunity.successMetric: A fresh synthetic case gains a funded accepted arrangement while staffing, full care, qualifications, consent and finite fallback remain intact; conventional parity and failures stay visible.
opportunity.thesis: Consenting roster changes across employers can concentrate fragmented care demand into a funded qualified opening. A coupled commitment instrument preserves production, individual choices and finite fallback obligations. Existing flexible-care and consortium services are strong prior art; the contribution is a tested bounded construction, not a claim of historical firstness.
opportunity.title: Joint roster commitments that make a care cohort fundable

transformation_witness.acceptance: Independent recomputation of the complete plan; no contract activation before every distinct responsible party grants consent and funds its obligation.
transformation_witness.binding_restriction: Fixed work rosters split demand across costly care blocks; no single employer controls the other employer or the provider opening decision.
falsifiers: No accepted plan after preserving all obligations
Existing fixed-roster alternative reaches same outcome at same full funding
Ordinary coordinated implementation already delivers equivalent value at comparable cost
Willingness to pay or permissions fail in actual intake
transformation_witness.original_useful_purpose: Parents receive complete care coverage for permitted work shifts while employers receive their required staffing and providers receive sufficient funded qualified capacity.
preserved_obligations: Employer shift quotas and working hours
Worker permitted options and required change compensation
Every child full interval including location-specific commute
Declared qualified staff, capacity, acceptable sites and staff time limits
Each payer ceiling and category restrictions
Explicit finite pre-start outage worlds, backup and refund accounting
transformation_witness.transformation: Jointly choose only individually permitted roster alternatives and issue conditional payer-backed opening, standby and reserve commitments before the day begins.

uncertainties: Source-linked assessment intervals are subjective ranking signals, not probabilities.
Market novelty and incumbent custom contracting remain unresolved.
Demand, paid API access, actual model token costs and buyer willingness are unobserved.
Synthetic staff qualification flags are declarations, not live license verification.
No physical childcare or legal approval has been supplied.
Construction feasibility does not prove Operational Alpha or net retained Alpha.
Original verifier acceptance omissions and economic pairing/reporting defects are preserved, corrected separately, and subject to fresh confirmation; evidence hashes bind this review snapshot only.
